Q1: How do I buy a domain name and web hosting in Pakistan step-by-step?

To buy domain and hosting in Pakistan: 1) Go to Zedgehost Domain Search to check your desired domain name (.PK or .COM). 2) Select a web hosting plan (e.g., Cheap Shared Hosting starting at Rs. 1,499/year). 3) Link your domain to the hosting order. 4) Select payment via Easypaisa, JazzCash, Raast, or Bank Transfer. Your hosting account is activated instantly after payment!

Step-by-Step Purchase Walkthrough

Starting a website for your business, online store, or blog in Pakistan requires two essential components: a Domain Name (your site’s address, e.g., yourbrand.pk) and Web Hosting (the server storage where your website files live). Here is the complete order workflow:

Search & Lock Your Domain Name

Use the domain search box to verify if your business name is available under .pk, .com.pk, or .com. Add it to your shopping cart.

Select the Right Web Hosting Plan

For new blogs and small business websites, select Shared Hosting (Starter Plan @ Rs. 1,499/year). For high-traffic WooCommerce stores, choose WordPress Hosting or Linux VPS Hosting.

Select Control Panel & Free SSL Options

Zedgehost automatically includes official cPanel and free Let's Encrypt SSL certificates with all hosting packages to ensure 100% security.

Checkout using Local PKR Payment Options

Choose Easypaisa, JazzCash, Raast Instant Pay, or Bank Transfer at checkout. Once paid, login details for cPanel are sent directly to your email.

Q2: How do I register a .PK or .COM.PK domain name in Pakistan, and what are the requirements?

Anyone in Pakistan or globally can register a .PK or .COM.PK domain name. Zedgehost lists .PK domain registration at Rs. 4,999; confirm the applicable registration term at checkout. No special documents are required for general .pk or .com.pk domains, while .edu.pk and .gov.pk require institutional authorization.

Q3: What local payment methods can I use to pay for web hosting in Pakistan without a credit card?

At Zedgehost, you do not need an international credit card or PayPal to buy web hosting. You can pay instantly in Pakistani Rupees (PKR) using Easypaisa, JazzCash, Raast ID, Visa/Mastercard debit cards, or local Bank Transfers (Meezan Bank, HBL, UBL, Allied Bank, etc.).

Accepted Pakistani Local Payment Options

Automated payment gateways instantly mark your order as paid and provision your server account within seconds, sending cPanel login details via email.

Q4: What is the difference between Shared, WordPress, and VPS hosting in Pakistan?

Shared Hosting is cheapest (Rs. 1,499/year) and best for new websites. WordPress Hosting is optimized specifically for WordPress speed, security, and automatic updates. VPS Hosting provides dedicated CPU/RAM resources and full root access for large e-commerce stores and high-traffic applications.

Q5: Why should I buy web hosting in PKR instead of USD from international providers?

Paying for web hosting in PKR protects you against US Dollar (USD) currency devaluation, avoids 3-5% international bank transaction taxes, eliminates credit card blocking issues by Pakistani banks, and offers 24/7 support in Urdu and English directly via local WhatsApp and phone lines.

Key Advantages of Local PKR Web Hosting:

  • Fixed Pricing Stability: Your monthly hosting bill remains constant regardless of USD/PKR exchange rate spikes.
  • No Foreign Tax Deductions: Save 3% to 5% advance withholding tax charged by Pakistani banks on international USD card payments.
  • Local Support Channel: Speak directly with senior technical support engineers via local phone and WhatsApp in Urdu.
  • Lower Latency for Pakistani Traffic: Fast routing for local visitors in Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, and Rawalpindi.

Q6: Does Zedgehost include cPanel, 1-Click WordPress, and free SSL certificates?

Yes. All Zedgehost shared and WordPress hosting packages come with official cPanel control panel, Softaculous 1-Click App Installer (to install WordPress, Joomla, Laravel in 1 click), and free Let's Encrypt AutoSSL that automatically secures your domain with HTTPS.
